content.text: The stats API caps each query at seven days, so I'll pull the full flight in two windows and add them up.

The Halloween campaign ran from Oct 23 through Oct 31, 2027 (Eastern) and spent $687.98 of the $700.00 budget. **I could not measure trial starts**, because the site has no X pixel. The campaign was optimized for link clicks.

**Results (Oct 23 – Oct 31, 2027)**

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $687.98 |
| Impressions | 679,298 |
| Link clicks | 329 |
| Cost per link click | ~$2.09 |
| Trial starts | Not tracked |

**By post**

| Post | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|
| 2244846133049296813 ("October 31 is the deadline…") | 367,635 | 217 |
| 2244664939118766301 ("Your next relay starts on screen…") | 311,663 | 112 |

**What I set up**
- Campaign "Yuzustride Halloween Trials 2027-10-23 to 10-31" with one ad group, "Halloween Trials - US/CA iOS+Android."
- Targeting: United States and Canada, iOS and Android only.
- Budget: $77.77 per day, $700.00 total, standard pacing.
- Both approved posts were promoted, and both were accepted. Destination was yuzustride.com/halloween.

**Things you should know**
- **Trial starts were not optimized or measured.** Without a pixel, X can't see trial starts. Optimizing for trials would require installing X's pixel on the site and a conversion goal. I did not create a pixel because there is nothing on your site to fire it.
- **I did not make any mid-flight changes.** I checked performance at intervals but left the campaign, budget, targeting and posts as launched. Given the link-click goal, I did not see a reason to change anything, but that means no optimization happened.
- The campaign has reached its end time and is no longer serving. I did not pause or delete it, so it's in place if you want to review it.
- The post copy and landing page are unchanged from what you approved. I didn't write any new ads.
